question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` preserve the currently accepted plus-prefixed and zero-padded digit spellings, or intentionally require canonical digits-only serialization?
rationale: The existing parser explicitly accepts these spellings, they produce the same numeric cadence, and public documentation does not define canonical serialization, so tests alone cannot determine whether breaking them is desired product policy.

options.title: Preserve current spellings
options.body: Keep the current parser and close or revise this PR because no incorrect cadence or existing contract violation has been demonstrated.

options.title: Require canonical digits
options.body: Explicitly approve the compatibility break, document canonical-only syntax, and require real CLI before/after/control proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve current spellings
recommendation.body: Keep the current parser and close or revise this PR because no incorrect cadence or existing contract violation has been demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and later refactored the bundled Policy feature and are best positioned to define its CLI contract.
